scope: Static independent source adjudication, no destructive PoCs or tests

findings.consumer: strict_reviewer calls purge immediately before git add/commit
findings.trigger: Existing database with uncheckpointed committed WAL pages under current directory
findings.guard_analysis: No database-open check or SQLite checkpoint; direct find -delete
findings.impact_scope: Loss of persisted WAL transactions or live SQLite consistency; invoking reviewer required

findings.consumer: ctypes wrapper forwards len(query) without minimum or equal batch-length validation
findings.trigger: Accelerator .so loaded; nonempty batch and query shorter than16 bytes ARM64 or64 bytes AVX512
findings.impact_scope: Out-of-bounds native reads/crash; accelerator availability conditional

findings.consumer: Public secure_delete_scoped API; scoped test callers found
findings.trigger: Crash or failure in budget/WAL write after successful quarantine
findings.guard_analysis: Authorization gates precede rename but recovery explicitly rejects absent WAL record
findings.impact_scope: Original pathname removed, file stranded in quarantine; content not necessarily destroyed. No production entrypoint traced.

findings.finding: Evidence compiler default invents successful observations
findings.consumer: compile_pack writes default_nemesis to evidence/nemesis-results.json and references it in claim artifacts; supported status itself is inherited from canonical raw status
findings.trigger: Default compile_pack invocation without external observation payload
findings.guard_analysis: No simulation marker around hard-coded ZERO_UNAUTHORIZED_EFFECTS_OVER_10000_TRIALS etc
findings.impact_scope: Generated compliance artifact falsely presents unexecuted observations as support; not a runtime authorization bypass

findings.finding: Evidence compiler recursively deletes arbitrary output
findings.trigger: Caller supplies existing directory containing valuable data or existing_ledger_path inside output dir
findings.guard_analysis: Path.absolute then unconditional rmtree before claims/input validation; no ownership marker or exclusion
findings.impact_scope: Loss of directory contents; explicit API invocation required, no remote untrusted path source established
